summary.text:
Global equities surged following the reinstatement of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, lifting Asian tech shares and pushing NVDA up 31.59% to 165.185. The Nasdaq climbed 6.86% to 26746.0957, the S&P 500 added 4.73% to 7237.1699, and Japan's Nikkei 225 gained 4.43% to 58937.0586. Market volatility dropped sharply, with the VIX plunging 25.83% to 26.62.

The US Dollar Index held flat at 104.224. The greenback strengthened against major peers, with EURUSD falling 0.49% to 1.0918 and GBPUSD declining 0.38% to 1.3045, while USDJPY slipped 0.04% to 158.866. Commodities were unchanged, with gold at 3671.8, Brent crude at 86.28, and WTI crude at 79.86. Bitcoin edged down 0.05% to 61133.5703.

Investors are monitoring Japanese economic activity after November manufacturing accelerated while services slowed. Markets are also watching the FAA investigation into an Amazon delivery drone crash and legal developments regarding meeting recordings possessed by an OpenAI engineer.
